audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3 and 4 read Skill while whys[3] and whys[4] say your durability neutralizes his trades and 'Level 6 is yours'; row 6 read Renekton while whys[6] says 'With two items you out-scale'. The packet chart is Skill / Renekton / Renekton / Urgot / Urgot / Renekton / Urgot.
audit.why: Renekton is a two-window bully — levels 2-3 and his first item — and falls off after that. The stored chart gave him the 2+ item row he does not win at a 55.64% Urgot win rate.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 4 and 6 flipped to Urgot as matched full/content pairs, ratings 6/10, 6/10 and 7/10. Rows 0, 1, 2 and 5 already matched the packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text says to 'flip with R', and spikes[2].text says to 'Hold W (Purge) to cleanse the tempo'.
audit.why: Fear Beyond Death impales and executes; Disdain (E) is the flip. Purge does not cleanse anything — Riot's text is that it self-slows Urgot while it fires and triggers Echoing Flames. Both lines told the reader an ability does something it cannot do.
audit.corrected: R impales and executes at 100s; Disdain is the flip and the only shield; neither cleanses.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nowhere on the page does it say what empowered Ruthless Predator does to Urgot specifically.
audit.why: This is the decisive interaction of the matchup and the mirror recorded it too. Riot's text: at more than 50 Fury, Ruthless Predator slashes three times, DESTROYING DAMAGE SHIELDS on the target, and stuns for 1.5 seconds instead of 0.75. Disdain (E) is Urgot's only shield and his only engage and escape. So a Renekton who holds 50 Fury deletes the shield you just spent 16 seconds of cooldown on and doubles the stun — meaning the correct play is to engage on an empty Fury bar, not merely on the W cooldown.
audit.corrected: At 50 Fury his W stuns 1.5s and destroys damage shields, including the Disdain shield. Ruthless Predator is 16s at rank 1 to 8s, Slice and Dice 16s to 10s, and Cull the Meek a flat 7s that heals him — Grievous Wounds early is what decides the extended trades.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns listed Ruthless Predator twice with no numbers.
audit.why: 16s W, 16s E and the Fury threshold are the three things to track.

edits.before: Renekton's dominant window: empowered W (Ruthless Predator) stun plus E (Slice and Dice) dash gives him a hard all-in that out-trades you with full fury. Do not feed his fury bar, dodge his Slice and only Q-poke when his E is on cooldown.
edits.after: Renekton's dominant window: at 50 Fury, Ruthless Predator (W) stuns 1.5s instead of 0.75s and destroys damage shields — including the one Disdain gives you. Do not feed his Fury, and poke only while Slice and Dice (E, 16s) is down.

edits.before: Your R (Fear Beyond Death) neutralizes his all-in. If he E-Ws onto you, Purge him and flip with R before he can Dice out, since he has no execute of his own.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death (R), 100s, neutralizes his all-in: if he dashes in, Purge him, then impale and execute before the second Dice takes him back out.

edits.before: Renekton stays ahead with a first item and low fury cooldowns; he can point-blank stun-combo you. Hold W (Purge) to cleanse the tempo and do not get caught with his fury above half.
edits.after: Renekton stays ahead with a first item; his stun combo is point-blank. Purge does not cleanse anything — hold Disdain for after the empowered W, since that W deletes the Disdain shield anyway.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 belong to Renekton. His fury-empowered W stun and E dash give him a hard all-in that out-trades your slow legs; respect the window, only poke when his E is down, and stall until R.
edits.after: Levels 2-3 belong to Renekton. Ruthless Predator (16s at rank 1) empowers at 50 Fury into a 1.5s stun that also breaks your Disdain shield; poke only while Slice and Dice is down, and stall to level 6.

edits.before: Trade only when his fury bar is low and E is down
edits.after: Trade with his Fury low, and cut his Q heal early

edits.before: Build fury early then empowered-W stun into a full combo
edits.after: Reach 50 Fury for the long stun that breaks shields

edits.before: - Renekton Ruthless Predator (Stun): matchup-defining — Empowered = long stun. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Renekton Ruthless Predator: Empowered strike; with Fury it stuns longer — his all-in lockdown. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Ruthless Predator (W), 16s at rank 1 to 8s: at 50 Fury it stuns 1.5s instead of 0.75s and destroys damage shields, so it eats your Disdain shield. - Slice and Dice (E), 16s to 10s: his dash in and his dash back out.

edits.before: Empowered = long stun. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: At 50 Fury it stuns 1.5s and breaks your Disdain shield. Bait it.

notes: The mirror reported this chart as self-consistent and matching the packet; it is not — rows 3, 4 and 6 disagree with both the packet and this page's own whys, so I flipped them. The page's most valuable missing fact is that empowered Ruthless Predator destroys damage shields: Disdain is Urgot's only shield and simultaneously his only engage and escape, so the engage condition is an empty Fury bar, not just a W on cooldown. Also unverified and left untouched, same as the mirror: several strings across this champion claim Echoing Flames deals percent-max-health damage. Riot's text says only 'physical damage' and there is no percentHealth flag on any Urgot ability.
